key_concepts.formula: The ratio of two quantities a and b in the same units is a/b, written a : b. a is antecedent, b is consequent. Multiplying or dividing both terms by non-zero k gives equal ratio.

a : b :: c : d iff a/b = c/d. Product of extremes = Product of means (a × d = b × c). Fourth proportional to a,b,c is d = (b × c)/a. Third proportional to a,b is c = b²/a. Mean proportional between a and b = √(a × b).
(a:b) > (c:d) iff a/b > c/d. Compounded ratio of (a:b) and (c:d) is (a×c : b×d). Duplicate ratio = a²:b², Triplicate ratio = a³:b³, Sub-duplicate = √a:√b, Sub-triplicate = ∛a:∛b.
If a/b = c/d, then (a + b)/(a − b) = (c + d)/(c − d).

key_concepts.topic: Division of Quantity in Given Ratio
key_concepts.formula: If amount A is divided into parts in ratio a:b:c, then first part = A × a/(a+b+c), second part = A × b/(a+b+c), third part = A × c/(a+b+c).
